text:
mira (Marketing): ok team — we need a short, clear benchmark narrative for next week's webinar. focus: latency vs unit cost. aim for 2 charts + 2 talking bullets. who can grab final numbers?

sam (Data Science): I can pull p50/p95 latency and cost-per-1M tokens across the models we'll show. want hosted + quantized dedicated variants?

jonah (Engineering): yes please include: hosted-vanilla, dedicated-8xA100-qa, private-qlora-4bit. also annotate when KV cache triggers.

lina (Product): high-level messaging: "predictable latency at target unit cost" and a fallback story — show how routing -> cheaper variant keeps SLAs. two bullets: 1) typical app SLOs we can hit, 2) cost delta vs naive hosting.

mira (Marketing): good. sam, can you give a suggested chart pair: one scatter (latency vs cost) and one stacked bar (cost breakdown: compute, storage, infra)?

sam (Data Science): yep. proposed visuals:
- scatter.csv (model, p95_latency_ms, cost_per_1M_tokens_usd, color=variant)
- stacked.csv (model, compute_usd, infra_usd, caching_savings_usd)

Here is sample CSV preview:
```
model,p95_ms,cost_usd_per_1M,variant
redwood-xl,210,45,hosted
redwood-xl,180,30,dedicated-8x
open-vicuna,420,12,private-qlora
```

and stacked snippet:
```
model,compute,infra,caching
redwood-xl,38,5,2
redwood-xl-dedicated,25,3,2
open-qlora,10,1,1
```

mira (Marketing): perfect. tess can you craft two bullets from lina's input for slide copy?

tess (Content): on it. draft bullets: 1) "Serve predictable p95 latency (sub-250ms) for interactive experiences while cutting token costs up to 40% via dedicated variants and KV caching." 2) "Graceful fallbacks: route to lower-cost model variants to preserve SLAs under load — measurable impact on cost per 1M tokens."

jonah (Engineering): also add a small note under chart: "measurements on 4k context, steady-state traffic, batching disabled for p95" — avoids confusion about batching effects.

sam (Data Science): I'll run final queries tonight against the benchmark harness and post the exact numbers + alt variant with batching turned on. ops-bot will post the CI run.

ops-bot: benchmark-run #872 started by sam — collecting p50/p95 and cost traces. URL: https://bench.redwood/872

mira (Marketing): timeline: need charts + copy by EOD tomorrow for the webinar deck. after sam posts numbers we'll pick final visuals.

lina (Product): also consider an appendix slide with per-route cost breakdown and a tiny explainer of quantization tradeoffs. keeps the main slide clean.

sam (Data Science): posted results — small table + CSV attached in drive: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/latency-cost-1763678901.csv

mira (Marketing): thanks. quick check: p95 for redwood-xl hosted = 210ms, cost 45; dedicated = 180ms cost 30; open-qlora p95 420ms cost 12. those line up with messaging?

tess (Content): yes — I'll write 1 short headline: "Balance latency and unit economics — pick the right variant for your SLO" and two bullets from earlier.

jonah (Engineering): minor ask: call out that open-qlora was measured on CPU+4-bit quant and may have higher variance on bursty traffic.

mira (Marketing): great catch. add small footnote. ok finalize copies and I'll drop screenshots into the slide deck. tagging everyone: thanks! :rocket:
